name: Senkou no Ix -Disorder Eclipse-
source:
A catastrophic war caused immense damage to the planet, rendering most of it uninhabitable. As time passed, humanity gradually recovered. They buried records about weapons used during the war so that future generations wouldn't repeat the same mistakes. Even so, no secret stays hidden forever, and there's no shortage of people trying to unearth artifacts from the war for their own malicious purposes. Kouga, a member of the Artifact Management Division, works together with his partner Ikusu to stop these criminals, but when their latest job doesn't go to plan and Ikusu gets kidnapped, something far more sinister than anything they could have imagined is set in motion...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4353600/Radiance_of_Annihilation_Disorder_Eclipse/]Steam[/url]]

An adaptation of a [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ397118.html]CG Collection[/url].
translation:
一场灾难性的战争对地球造成了巨大的破坏，使其大部分地区无法居住。随着时间的流逝，人类逐渐复苏。他们埋葬了战争期间使用的武器记录，以免后代重蹈覆辙。即便如此，没有什么秘密是永远隐藏的，也不乏有人为了自己的恶意目的而试图从战争中挖掘出文物。古我是神器管理科的一员，他与他的搭档几须一起阻止这些罪犯，但当他们的最新工作没有按计划进行并且几须被绑架时，比他们想象的更险恶的事情开始了……
